task: Google sign-up is broken. Diagnose and fix the root cause without changing working email or OTP authentication, and add the smallest regression check that proves the failure is gone.
variant: SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hook injects RepoTracer routing plus writing guidance for Codex Sol.
diagnosis: The hook successfully caused RepoTracer to be called first.
The agent still ran broad repository searches after the handoff, so the awareness text did not enforce the intended bounded workflow.

The scout handoff scoped the application auth flow but did not surface the production blue-green deployment file; the implementation updated compose.yaml while missing the actual production x-web-env block.
The regression check proved an extracted provider helper, not the production auth.ts composition, and therefore could not catch removal of production wiring.
decision: Do not ship this hook variant. It increased cost and latency while materially reducing end-to-end correctness.
